originalTitle: US STOCKS SNAPSHOT-S&P 500, Nasdaq open higher after inflation data, earnings boost
simplifiedContent: The US stock market started the day on a positive note, with major indexes like the S&P 500 and Nasdaq going up. This happened after some new information about inflation was released, which was mostly what investors were expecting. Additionally, some companies that work with artificial intelligence reported good earnings, which also helped boost the market. The Dow Jones, S&P 500, and Nasdaq all saw increases at the start of the day. This matters because it suggests that investors are feeling optimistic about the market, at least for now.

originalTitle: MCX, NISM launch centre to strengthen India’s commodity market skills
simplifiedContent: Two organizations, MCX and NISM, have partnered to create a new center that will help improve skills and knowledge in India's commodity market. This center will focus on teaching professionals, doing research, educating investors, and working with academic institutions. The goal is to help people better understand and work with commodity derivatives, manage risks, and follow rules. This is important because it can help make India's commodity market stronger and more reliable. By doing this, MCX and NISM hope to make commodity markets work better and more safely for everyone involved.

originalTitle: Gokaldas Exports Q1 profit jumps 7% as US tariff pressure eases
simplifiedContent: Gokaldas Exports, a company, made a profit of ₹44 crore in the first quarter of the financial year, which is 7% more than what they made last year. The company's income also increased by 21% to ₹1,180 crore. This improvement happened because the pressure from US tariffs, which are like taxes on imported goods, has eased. As a result, the company was able to get more orders from India and Africa, and they were also able to work more efficiently. This news matters because it shows that the company is recovering and doing better, which could be good for investors.

originalTitle: Penny stock under  ₹5 hits upper circuit after Q1 results 2026
simplifiedContent: A small company called NHC Foods, whose stock price is very low (under ₹5), saw its stock price rise by 5% to ₹1.30 after releasing its quarterly financial results. The company did well in the first quarter, with its revenue (the amount of money it made) increasing by 234.54% compared to the same time last year. The company also made more profit, with a huge increase of 919.81%. This good news caused many people to want to buy the stock, which is why the price went up. The company also announced plans to invest in another company called Agriconnect Solutions.

originalTitle: Blackstone-backed Horizon bets on India’s warehouse boom with  ₹2,600 crore IPO
simplifiedContent: A company called Horizon Industrial Parks, which is supported by a big investment firm called Blackstone, is planning to raise ₹2,600 crore through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This means they want to sell shares of their company to the public to get more money. The company plans to use this money to grow its business in India by expanding in cities where they already have a presence, entering new cities, and finding new customers. This is a big deal because India's industrial and warehousing sector is changing quickly, with more institutional investors like Blackstone getting involved. By raising more money, Horizon Industrial Parks is trying to take advantage of the growing demand for warehouses in India.

originalTitle: Motilal Oswal bullish on jewellery stocks; picks Titan, Kalyan Jewellers as top bets, sees up to 34% upside
simplifiedContent: Motilal Oswal, a financial company, thinks that jewelry stocks are a good investment right now. They especially like two companies, Titan and Kalyan Jewellers, and think their stock prices could go up by as much as 34%. This is because people are buying more jewelry from established companies, rather than small, informal sellers, which is a trend that is expected to continue. As a result, big jewelry retailers like Titan and Kalyan Jewellers are likely to gain more market share, making them good investments. This means that if you invest in these companies, you might see a significant increase in the value of your investment.
